articles.title: Scarborough busway opening Sept. 30: TTC
articles.summary: The Scarborough busway, a dedicated transit corridor being built to replace the area's defunct Line 3 train service, is opening Sept. 30, the TTC says.

articles.title: Scarborough Busway set to open on Sept. 30

The four-kilometre busway will operate between Kennedy and Ellesmere stations then connect to Scarborough Town Centre through Ellesmere Road’s priority bus infrastructure. articles.summary: Recently resigned Liberal MP Shaun Chen is throwing his hat in for a Toronto city council position.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after crash in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A man has died in hospital after a motorcycle crash in Scarborough Wednesday evening, police said.

articles.title: Toronto councillor Paula Fletcher announces retirement from municipal politics
articles.summary: Toronto city councillor Paula Fletcher says she is retiring from city hall and will not seek re-election in the October municipal election.

articles.title: Botched opening day of Markham Indy race forces race president to apologize
articles.summary: The president of the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham is proud of how the event came together, but he's sorry that most fans went home disappointed after the event's opening day.
